source_inputs.root279_pair_manifest: The prepared ROOT279 same-CFL/half-CFL pair manifest is the producer identity and selected-frame authority.
source_inputs.root279_guard_result: Bound only after ROOT279/ROOT310 terminal completion with concrete SHA/stat.
source_inputs.root279_child_report: The guarded child observer JSON is bound independently; an outer wrapper is not an observer report.
source_inputs.calibration_card: The preregistered F1-S2 bracket and tolerance card is immutable input.

query_contract.saved_time_brackets: Use the actual lower/upper saved times from the ROOT279 child report; selected-index adjacency is not a native-time error bound.

field_contract.missing_massfluid: UNKNOWN; XML mass is never a fallback.
field_contract.source_roles: Fluid-only observables are kept separate from bound/fixed roles and component-space axis qualification.

error_separation.integrator_cfl_difference: UNKNOWN when saved times differ; no bracket slope is promoted to an error bound.

negative_cases: missing or XML-only MassFluid must remain UNKNOWN
selected-frame/index or bracket mismatch must fail
changed output interval/control or interpolation flag must fail
outer wrapper JSON presented as the child observer report must fail
